parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: MessageTimeEarlierThan
parameters.description: Filters messages with a time earlier than the specified value.

parameters.name: MessageTimeLaterThan
parameters.description: Filters messages with a time later than the specified value.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. This parameter indicates that there is a next page as long as data is returned. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data until Null is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.
